name: bg-scale-hover
summary: Navigation menu with a full-bleed background image that scales up on item hover, revealed through an expanding clip window.

deviations.what: GSAP tweens → anime.js v4. Easing names: Power2.easeOut → easeOutPower2. Timeline management moved to individual animate() calls.
deviations.why: GSAP licence forbids use in tools that let people build animations without code, which paw-fx is. Every duration, easing curve and stagger is upstream's; only the spelling moved.
